_note: A slot prop that comes from an {#each} item is typed through upstream's unwrapArr<T>(arr: ArrayLike<T>): T. Only an array-like source yields its item type; a Set infers unknown, so the consumer's let:item is unknown (TS18046 on use), while an array source keeps number (TS2339 on a bad member). Before, the helper also unwrapped iterables and the Set item was typed. Verified against upstream svelte-check --tsgo.
